thread:
Emma (Head of Product): thanks for the turnout. quick live Q&A to close the loop on why we won/lost recent pilots + concrete asks. i'll keep it tight.
Raj (Sales): win signals = pilot metric alignment (p95 stability) + clear handoff docs. loss signals = no HSM path, poor error-mode UX (requests fail silently), and surprise accuracy drops after model switchover.
Sophia (CS): concrete loss: RetailEdge paused because our pilot lacked a documented fallback when dedicated nodes saturated; their page errors during peak.
Ben (Customer Success): heard consistently: 1) "one-week VPC fast-path", 2) explicit fallback behavior (auto-router to hosted model + customer alert), 3) regression repro kits, 4) billing caps to avoid surprise spikes.
Lin (Eng PM): engineering note: short wins = clearly documented fallback policy + small router patch to emit 429 vs shadow routing; estimate 1 sprint. medium = terraform VPC quickstart + onboarding scripts, 3-4 sprints. long = HSM/bring-your-own-HSM integration, 3+ months with legal/security signoff.
Maria (Applied ML): model drift root cause for two customers = unpinned quant/profile change + prompt surface mismatch. mitigation: add a pre-deploy sampled-run of top N customer prompts and fail deploy on >X% regression. small CI hook, low effort.
Keisha (Legal): on SLA & HSM asks  we can draft an addendum template for HSM and a latency SLA appendix, but need clarity on supported regions and indemnities. legal lead time ~2 weeks for templates.
Tom (Finance): pricing question  customers might accept a "latency premium" if we cap financial exposure. need a pricing model: expected extra infra cost + credit policy. i can run numbers if product defines p95 targets.
David (CEO): leadership ask: can product/eng/legal produce a 1-page commitment that we can share with prospects listing scope, timeline, risks? aim: next Wed review.
Emma (Head of Product): yes  i'll own the one-pager. proposed owners: Lin = VPC quickstart plan, Maria = regression CI hook + FAQ, Ben+Raj = loss-playbook mapping signals -> responses, Keisha = contract templates, Tom = pricing for latency tiers.
Raj (Sales): small operational Q: can fallback include a rate-limited downgrade with an email + webhook to customer? makes it easier for them to reconcile.
Lin (Eng PM): yes  we can add a "notify+downgrade" flow: when dedicated pool is >= 95% utilization, route new sessions to hosted medium model and emit event. PRD snippet:
```
if pool_util >= 0.95:
  route_to(hosted_medium)
  send_webhook(customer_url, {reason: "capacity_fallback"})
```
Estimate: 1 sprint to ship a basic version.
Sophia (CS): please include default messaging templates for that webhook + customer email so CS can use in pilots.
Ben (Customer Success): i'll compile the templates and example SLA language from prospects and upload to the playbook doc.
Maria (Applied ML): adding note: include a small band of token-cost examples in the FAQ for common batching/quant profiles so sales can discuss tradeoffs in pilots.
Keisha (Legal): i'll draft two short contract appendices: HSM addendum and latency SLA appendix. will need input from eng on measurable indicators.
allhands-bot: :spiral_calendar: action created: "deal-retro one-pager" owner: Emma, due: 7 days; "loss-playbook" owner: Ben, due: 14 days; "VPC quickstart plan" owner: Lin, due: 10 days.

Emma (Head of Product): will post draft here and convert into tickets after review: https://redwoodhq.internal/allhands/1940001234-notes. please keep follow-ups short so i can synthesize.
